limits_stated: Post-hoc: adopted after observing 123222Z; not evidence that a pre-registered rule passed.
G4: the inverse tails are internal to DL under load (venue -> DL ~30 ms; receive -> CreateTime 154-295 ms, CreateTime -> observer 115-206 ms); A4 changes the statistic, not the latency.
G4: the inverse window maximum is report-only (387.1 / 406.7 / 531.9 ms in 123222Z); no max limit applies to these three rows under A4.

G2: the split of the MARK BINANCE tail between DL Query and the TS writer's wake / min-interval / 1 s refresh read scheduling is unknown (trace basis ADAPTER_REFERENCE_RETURN); IDR-126 adds wake/poll markers.

G2: with 1000 ms Binance cadence a 1082.9 ms transit leaves the previous MARK event older than 2000 ms for about 83 ms; TS Risk on the MARK quiet contract applies no event-age check (code reading, not a captured read).
No TS order admission was observed during the load; 'no refusal' rests on G6 / G9 samplers and worker logs.
